request.style: English, male baritone solo, choral backing, harp, organ, strings, solemn, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Son of Jeconiah the captive
Heir of the royal blood
Shealtiel his name was given
In the darkened time of God

[Verse]
Father of the governor
Leading Judah's returning
Zerubbabel his name was known
In the exile's ending

[Verse]
Haggai spoke the Lord's command
To the house that lay in ruin
Timber bring to hill and field
Let the temple be rebuilt

[Verse]
Stirred the spirit of the man
And the priest beside him standing
Work begun upon the house
Of the hosts of Israel's land

[Verse]
Matthew traced the royal line
From David's throne to Jesus
Shealtiel stands in the record
King and prophet's measure

[Verse]
Luke also named the son
Of Zerubbabel's father
Shealtiel the link is clear
In the Messiah's path we measure

[Outro]
God's promise holds the line
